from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor

# Create presentation
prs = Presentation()
# Use a blank slide layout for title (index 0) and title and content (index 1)
title_slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]
bullet_slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]

# Helper to add title and content
def add_title_slide(title, subtitle=None):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(title_slide_layout)
    title_placeholder = slide.shapes.title
    subtitle_placeholder = slide.placeholders[1]
    title_placeholder.text = title
    title_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(44)
    title_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
    if subtitle:
        subtitle_placeholder.text = subtitle
        subtitle_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(24)

def add_bullet_slide(title, bullet_points):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(bullet_slide_layout)
    shapes = slide.shapes
    title_shape = shapes.title
    body_shape = shapes.placeholders[1]
    title_shape.text = title
    title_shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(32)
    title_shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
    tf = body_shape.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    for i, point in enumerate(bullet_points):
        p = tf.add_paragraph() if i > 0 else tf.paragraphs[0]
        p.text = point
        p.level = 0
        p.font.size = Pt(20)
        p.font.name = 'Calibri'
        p.space_after = Pt(6)

# Slide content
add_title_slide("India: A Comprehensive Overview", "Prepared for Desktop Presentation")

add_bullet_slide("Overview", [
    "Official Name: Republic of India",
    "Capital: New Delhi",
    "Population: ~1.4 billion (2023)",
    "Official Languages: Hindi, English (22 officially recognized)",
    "Government: Federal parliamentary democratic republic"
])

add_bullet_slide("Geography", [
    "Location: South Asia, bounded by Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal",
    "Area: 3.287 million km² (7th largest country)",
    "Major Physical Features: Himalayas, Indo-Gangetic Plain, Thar Desert, Deccan Plateau",
    "Climate: Varies from tropical monsoon in south to temperate in north",
    "Key Rivers: Ganges, Brahmaputra, Indus, Godavari, Krishna"
])

add_bullet_slide("Culture & Heritage", [
    "Rich cultural diversity: 28 states, 8 union territories",
    "Major Religions: Hinduism, Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Buddhism, Jainism",
    "UNESCO World Heritage Sites: 40+ (e.g., Taj Mahal, Jaipur City, Hampi)",
    "Classical Dance Forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Kuchipudi",
    "Festivals: Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas, Pongal, Navratri"
])

add_bullet_slide("Economy", [
    "Nominal GDP: ~$3.7 trillion (2023) – 5th largest globally",
    "Major Sectors: Services (~55%), Industry (~25%), Agriculture (~20%)",
    "Key Industries: Information Technology, Pharmaceuticals, Textiles, Automobiles, Steel",
    "Export Partners: USA, UAE, China, Hong Kong, Singapore",
    "Growth Rate: ~6-7% annual (pre‑pandemic average)"
])

add_bullet_slide("Tourism", [
    "Top Destinations: Taj Mahal (Agra), Jaipur (Pink City), Kerala Backwaters, Goa Beaches",
    "Tourist Arrivals: ~10 million foreign tourists annually (pre‑COVID)",
    "Eco‑Tourism: Western Ghats, Sundarbans, Himalayan treks",
    "Cultural Tourism: Varanasi, Khajuraho, Mysore Palace",
    "Adventure Tourism: River rafting in Rishikesh, skiing in Gulmarg"
])

add_bullet_slide("Science & Technology", [
    "Space Program: ISRO – Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, Gaganyaan",
    "Nuclear Capability: Civilian nuclear power, strategic arsenal",
    "IT & Software: Bangalore as 'Silicon Valley of India', major global exporter",
    "Pharmaceuticals: Leading producer of generic vaccines and medicines",
    "Renewable Energy: 4th largest wind power, 5th largest solar capacity"
])

add_bullet_slide("Conclusion", [
    "India blends ancient traditions with rapid modern development",
    "Strategic geopolitical player in Indo‑Pacific region",
    "Challenges: Poverty alleviation, infrastructure, environmental sustainability",
    "Opportunities: Demographic dividend, innovation, global partnerships",
    "Thank you!"
])

# Save to Desktop
output_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop/India_Presentation.pptx"
prs.save(output_path)
print(f"Presentation saved to {output_path}")

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_AUTO_SHAPE_TYPE

# Colors
TITLE_COLOR = RGBColor(0x00, 0x33, 0x66)  # Dark blue
SUBTITLE_COLOR = RGBColor(0x00, 0x66, 0x99)  # Blue
BODY_COLOR = RGBColor(0x20, 0x20, 0x20)  # Dark gray
ACCENT_COLOR = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x66, 0x00)  # Orange
BG_COLOR = RGBColor(0xF2, 0xF2, 0xF2)  # Light gray

prs = Presentation()
# Use blank layout for title, title and content for others
title_slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]
bullet_slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]

def set_background(slide, color=BG_COLOR):
    fill = slide.background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_title_slide(title, subtitle=None):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(title_slide_layout)
    set_background(slide)
    title_placeholder = slide.shapes.title
    subtitle_placeholder = slide.placeholders[1]
    title_placeholder.text = title
    title_para = title_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    title_para.font.size = Pt(44)
    title_para.font.bold = True
    title_para.font.color.rgb = TITLE_COLOR
    if subtitle:
        subtitle_placeholder.text = subtitle
        subtitle_para = subtitle_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
        subtitle_para.font.size = Pt(24)
        subtitle_para.font.color.rgb = SUBTITLE_COLOR
    # Add hyperlink to Incredible India website
    # Add a shape covering the slide? Instead add a small icon or text at bottom
    # We'll add a text box at bottom left with hyperlink
    left = Inches(0.5)
    top = Inches(6.5)
    width = Inches(3)
    height = Inches(0.5)
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.text = "Learn more: Incredible India"
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.font.size = Pt(14)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x66, 0xCC)  # Blue link
    p.font.underline = True
    # Set hyperlink
    click = txBox.click_action
    click.hyperlink.address = "https://www.incredibleindia.org"
    click.hyperlink.action = 'ppactionhyperlink'
    return slide

def add_bullet_slide(title, bullet_points, slide_index=None):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(bullet_slide_layout)
    set_background(slide)
    shapes = slide.shapes
    title_shape = shapes.title
    body_shape = shapes.placeholders[1]
    title_shape.text = title
    title_para = title_shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    title_para.font.size = Pt(32)
    title_para.font.bold = True
    title_para.font.color.rgb = TITLE_COLOR
    # Add hyperlink to title shape to allow navigation? Not needed.
    tf = body_shape.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    for i, point in enumerate(bullet_points):
        p = tf.add_paragraph() if i > 0 else tf.paragraphs[0]
        p.text = point
        p.level = 0
        p.font.size = Pt(20)
        p.font.name = 'Calibri'
        p.font.color.rgb = BODY_COLOR
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
    # Add a "Learn More" button shape at bottom right
    left = Inches(6)
    top = Inches(6)
    width = Inches(1.5)
    height = Inches(0.5)
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_AUTO_SHAPE_TYPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_COLOR
    shape.line.color.rgb = ACCENT_COLOR
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.text = "More"
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.font.size = Pt(14)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    # Hyperlink placeholder: we can set to a generic search; but we can leave as none for now.
    # We'll set hyperlink to a placeholder like about:blank
    click = shape.click_action
    click.hyperlink.address = "about:blank"
    click.hyperlink.action = 'ppactionhyperlink'
    return slide

# Slide data
add_title_slide("India: A Comprehensive Overview", "Interactive & Colorful Presentation")

add_bullet_slide("Overview", [
    "Official Name: Republic of India",
    "Capital: New Delhi",
    "Population: ~1.4 billion (2023)",
    "Official Languages: Hindi, English (22 officially recognized)",
    "Government: Federal parliamentary democratic republic"
])

add_bullet_slide("Geography", [

    "Area: 3.287 million km² (7th largest country)",
    "Major Physical Features: Himalayas, Indo-Gangetic Plain, Thar Desert, Deccan Plateau",
    "Climate: Varies from tropical monsoon in south to temperate in north",
    "Key Rivers: Ganges, Brahmaputra, Indus, Godavari, Krishna"
])

add_bullet_slide("Culture & Heritage", [
    "Rich cultural diversity: 28 states, 8 union territories",
    "Major Religions: Hinduism, Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Buddhism, Jainism",
    "UNESCO World Heritage Sites: 40+ (e.g., Taj Mahal, Jaipur City, Hampi)",
    "Classical Dance Forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Kuchipudi",
    "Festivals: Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas, Pongal, Navratri"
])

add_bullet_slide("Economy", [
    "Nominal GDP: ~$3.7 trillion (2023) – 5th largest globally",
    "Major Sectors: Services (~55%), Industry (~25%), Agriculture (~20%)",
    "Key Industries: Information Technology, Pharmaceuticals, Textiles, Automobiles, Steel",
    "Export Partners: USA, UAE, China, Hong Kong, Singapore",
    "Growth Rate: ~6-7% annual (pre‑pandemic average)"
])

add_bullet_slide("Tourism", [
    "Top Destinations: Taj Mahal (Agra), Jaipur (Pink City), Kerala Backwaters, Goa Beaches",
    "Tourist Arrivals: ~10 million foreign tourists annually (pre‑COVID)",
    "Eco‑Tourism: Western Ghats, Sundarbans, Himalayan treks",
    "Cultural Tourism: Varanasi, Khajuraho, Mysore Palace",
    "Adventure Tourism: River rafting in Rishikesh, skiing in Gulmarg"
])

add_bullet_slide("Science & Technology", [
    "Space Program: ISRO – Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, Gaganyaan",
    "Nuclear Capability: Civilian nuclear power, strategic arsenal",
    "IT & Software: Bangalore as 'Silicon Valley of India', major global exporter",
    "Pharmaceuticals: Leading producer of generic vaccines and medicines",
    "Renewable Energy: 4th largest wind power, 5th largest solar capacity"
])

add_bullet_slide("Conclusion", [

    "Strategic geopolitical player in Indo‑Pacific region",
